diagnostic_evidence.quote: \sup _{t \in[0, T]} y_1(t)+\int_0^T y_2(t) \ d t \leq \delta A E
We choose the parameter $\delta = 3/2$, as it leads to the best results in numerical experiments for our test case.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof bounds y1(T')+∫_0^{T'}y2 for each T'. This gives sup y1 ≤ X and ∫_0^{T_M} y2 ≤ X separately, hence only Υ(T_M) ≤ 2X, not Υ(T_M) < θ. The statement is false for δ<2. Counterexample: a=0, y1(t)=A(1−t/T), y2=A/T. Then y1(T')+∫_0^{T'}y2=A, so the hypothesis holds for any B>0, and (cond_prop31) holds for B small. But sup y1+∫y2=2A>δA.

failure_location.quote: This implies $\Upsilon\left(T_M\right)<\theta$, hence $T_M=T$, and thus proves the Lemma if $A>0$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Run the continuation argument with sup y1 only; the nonlinear term involves only y1. This yields sup_t[y1(t)+∫_0^t y2] ≤ δAE under the same condition, so the combined bound becomes 2δAE. Propagate the factor 2 to stab_thm and main_thm i).
issues.overall_effect: The error bounds δAE in Theorem stab_thm and in Theorem main_thm i) are unproven and false in general for δ∈(1,2), including the δ=3/2 used in the experiments. Existence conclusions survive, since only the bound on sup y1 is needed for them.
issues.title: Adjusted Gronwall lemma drops the factor 2 needed to pass from pointwise to sup-plus-integral bounds
issues.why_classification: The condition and the method survive, but the stated quantitative estimator must be weakened by a factor 2 (a limited weakening). The claimed improvement over Bartels must also be reassessed.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Let $C_S$ and $C_S^{\prime}$ denote the constants of the Sobolev embeddings $H^1(\Omega) \hookrightarrow L^6(\Omega)$ and $H^1(\Omega) \hookrightarrow L^3(\Omega)$, respectively.
Hölder's inequality and again the Sobolev embedding $H^1 \hookrightarrow L^6$ in the second step

issues.failure_explanation: Interpolation gives ||e||_{L^3} ≤ ||e||_{L^2}^{1/2}||e||_{L^6}^{1/2}. The embedding only yields ||e||_{L^6} ≤ C_S||e||_{H^1}, with the full norm. The bound ||e||_{L^6} ≤ C_S|e|_{H^1} is false: take e a nonzero constant, and under Neumann conditions e need not have zero mean. Using the full norm adds a term like C_S^{3/2}C_ell|e|_{H^1}||e||_{L^2}^2, i.e. an extra nonlinearity ||e||^4 (β=1) that is absent from (energy_esti).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Redo the estimate with the full H^1 norm and absorb the extra |e|^2 piece. Keep the additional term B'||e||^4 and extend Proposition adj_gengronwall and the local continuation to the combined nonlinearity B'y1+B y1^2. Then re-derive the conditions and recompute the numerics.
issues.overall_effect: (energy_esti), and therefore the conditions (stab_cond) and (root), the estimators, and the existence corollaries, rest on an invalid inequality. The computed availability times are unjustified.
issues.title: Sobolev embedding H^1→L^6 used with the seminorm in the cubic error term
issues.why_classification: The method survives, but the stability inequality, both conditions, and the Gronwall-type lemma must be re-derived with modified constants. This is a contained but nontrivial reworking.

issues.failure_explanation: (noncomp_esti) bounds ||e(t)||^2+∫_{t^n}^t|e|^2 for each t. Taking the sup of the first term together with the full integral only gives a factor 2. Moreover, the local bounds control ∫_{t^n}^{t^{n+1}}|e|^2 ≤ Ψ_n on each interval only. Summing gives Σ_nΨ_n, not Ψ_{N_t-1}, because A_{n+1} carries only ||e(t^{n+1})||^2 and not the accumulated integral. The α→0 limit also fails in the double-root case of (root).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Run the argument for the cumulative quantity z(t)=||e(t)||^2+∫_0^t|e|^2, using z(t^n) ≤ Ψ_{n-1}. This keeps the root conditions (require two distinct roots or a strict inequality) and gives sup||e||^2+∫_0^T|e|^2 ≤ 2Ψ_{N_t-1}.
issues.overall_effect: The global error bound Ψ_{N_t-1} of Theorem stab_cont and of main_thm ii) is not established. The existence corollary survives, since it needs only finiteness.
issues.title: Local continuation: pointwise bound turned into sup-plus-integral, and local integrals not accumulated
issues.why_classification: The method and conditions survive, but the stated bound must be changed and the iteration re-argued. This is a limited weakening with a contained repair.

issues.failure_explanation: From (Tr), h_F^{-1}||v||_F^2 ≤ c_Tr^2(h_F^{-1}||v||_K+||∇v||_K)^2 ≤ 2c_Tr^2(h_F^{-2}||v||_K^2+||∇v||_K^2). The factor 2 is dropped, so c_R is too small by √2. The same omission of (a+b)^2 ≤ 2a^2+2b^2 occurs in conv-res for the term with M_K(φ)−M_L(φ), so c_R' is too small as well.

issues.why_classification: This is a routine local constant correction; the method, rates and claims survive.

issues.failure_explanation: Adding and subtracting ρ̃^1 leaves the term ∫(ρ̃^1−ρ̃^0)(∇c̃^0−∇c_h^0)·∇φ. Its absolute value is bounded by +||ρ̃^1−ρ̃^0||_∞ η_Ω^0. Subtracting a nonnegative quantity in an upper bound is unjustified, and Θ_{K,0} is defined by summing these bounds.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the minus by a plus and recompute Θ_{K,0}.
issues.overall_effect: The first-step residual estimator may underestimate the residual, so A and A_0 in main_thm are not certified upper bounds.
